q.en: How can I contact the clinic?

a.id: Nomor 0227217318 tercantum pada direktori publik; konfirmasikan identitas klinik saat menghubungi.
a.en: Public listings show 0227217318. Confirm the clinic’s identity when calling.

a.en: Komp. Suci Residence Blok A-2, Jl. Padasuka No.55, Pasirlayung, Cibeunying Kidul, Bandung 40192. Confirm directions before travelling.

q.en: What should I prepare before visiting?

a.id: Tanyakan jadwal serta dokumen yang diminta klinik sebelum kunjungan.
a.en: Ask about appointment times and required documents before visiting.
